service.en: Treatment abroad for a foreign child of an Emirati mother
service.ar: طلب العلاج في الخارج لابن مواطنة غير حامل للجنسية
service.ur: اماراتی ماں کے غیر ملکی بچے کے لیے بیرون ملک علاج
service.ml: എമിറാത്തി അമ്മയുടെ വിദേശ പൗരത്വമുള്ള കുട്ടിക്ക് വിദേശ ചികിത്സ

about: Treatment abroad request for a patient who is a foreign child of an Emirati mother.
aliases: Treatment abroad child of Emirati mother
note: Requirements read from the official Department of Health Abu Dhabi FAQ page on the checked date. Details are filled in after sign-in, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

documents: Copy of the patient's passport and residence permit
Medical reports not older than 3 months
Copy of the patient's birth certificate
Copy of the mother's ID card
Optional: mother's family book and the patient's insurance card
channels: TAMM website or app, or a TAMM service centre
